title: Understanding LLM Evaluator Behavior: A Structured Multi-Evaluator Framework for Merchant Risk Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Using a consensus-deviation metric to compare an LLM judge's score of its own generated rationale against the mean score assigned by all other LLM judges, measured under both attributed (source model disclosed) and anonymized (source concealed) conditions to identify self-preference or self-critique.

Calculating the deviation of an LLM judge's score from the peer consensus when evaluating rationales generated by other specific models, identifying systematic leniency or harshness (off-diagonal matrix analysis).
